data.creator_notes:
With both of your parents always busy traveling for work, you had a pretty regular babysitter who you actually already knew from school. After you shrink, your parents still don't have time to take care of you, so they sign you over to your babysitter's custody. Surely she will continue to take care of you like she always has, and has no other intentions now that you're shrunk, right?

Various greetings for different preset characters. The first greeting has you describe a custom caretaker. Comment if you think of any presets that you think should get added.
Art by ZenouGTS
